notes: Each case names the pitfall id it guards. E14 added after the official-copy integration: `node -e` argv indexing (no script placeholder) and URI percent-encoding both produced ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND with misleading blame.

cases.prompt: 把 meta-partner 这个角色装到桌面端，让它每轮自动生效。
must_do: state that dsh plugin --profile desktop is rejected by rejectElectronProfile
route to the workspace-package path: <profile>/packages/<pkg> + workspace:* + dsh.profile.bundles + pnpm install --ignore-scripts
must_not_do: run dsh plugin --profile desktop
claim success after creating a symlink
cases.failure_mode_if_wrong: The user waits for a mount that the CLI will never perform.

cases.prompt: 插件装好了，但我在这个界面看不到，为什么？
must_do: identify which profile serves the URL before proposing any fix
name profile isolation as the first hypothesis
must_not_do: reinstall the plugin blindly
assume the GUI is the profile that was modified
cases.failure_mode_if_wrong: A correct install is torn down and redone against the wrong profile.

cases.prompt: 我写了一个 cordis.patch.yml，第一行是 plugins:，启动报 must be a top-level YAML array。
must_do: identify the mapping-versus-sequence defect
also check that the package declares dsh.bundle.patch
must_not_do: edit unrelated plugin code
reinstall
cases.failure_mode_if_wrong: The real defect survives a reinstall and the error repeats.

cases.prompt: dsh --profile web --dump-config 报 EPERM，是不是插件坏了？
must_do: classify as permission, not structure
fall back to loadProfileDirectory as the read-only gate
must_not_do: report the mount as successful
rewrite the bundle
cases.failure_mode_if_wrong: A correct bundle is modified to chase a sandbox error; the gate is declared failed when it was merely blocked.

cases.prompt: 用 npx 起的 dsh 启动就崩，报 koffi code signature。
must_do: name the app launcher under runtime/cli/bin/dsh as the supported entry
must_not_do: reinstall the plugin
strip code signatures
cases.failure_mode_if_wrong: An unrelated environment defect is attributed to the role.

cases.prompt: 我改了这个技能的内容，为什么加载的还是旧版？
must_do: enumerate the six skill roots with ranks
check for a higher-rank duplicate that shadows the edited copy
must_not_do: tell the user to restart the app first
cases.failure_mode_if_wrong: The edited file is correct and the user keeps loading a stale shadow.

cases.prompt: 给我的 SOUL.md 加上 {{user_name}} 让它自动填名字。
must_do: explain that renderPrompt interpolates strictly and throws on unregistered variables
state that interpolate: false is not an API
offer registration via systemPrompt.variable() or static text
must_not_do: add interpolate: false and call it fixed
cases.failure_mode_if_wrong: Prompt assembly throws on every request and the cause looks unrelated to the edit.

cases.prompt: 这个技能的 description 可以写多长？
must_do: state the 500-character catalog cap and the 450 safety margin
must_not_do: say there is no limit
cases.failure_mode_if_wrong: The negative trigger boundary is truncated and the skill misfires on adjacent tasks.

cases.prompt: SOUL.md 改了一条规矩，桌面端的 persona 会不会自动跟上？
must_do: state that the persona prefix is a hand-maintained partial copy and does not track SOUL.md
run check_persona_drift.py and report the missing clause list rather than judging by eye
must_not_do: answer from the persona text alone
claim consistency without measuring
cases.failure_mode_if_wrong: A drifted prefix keeps sounding authoritative while a real rule has quietly disappeared.

cases.prompt: 我在 AGENTS.md 里写「会抛错，除非设置 interpolate: false 并处理 {{variable}}」，可以吗？
must_do: flag that the literal double-brace token makes the injectable slot fail P08
rewrite the sentence to name the shape without the braces
must_not_do: keep the braces because the sentence is only explanatory
cases.failure_mode_if_wrong: Documenting a hazard creates the hazard: the file that mentions the placeholder becomes un-injectable.

cases.prompt: persona 前缀我压成锚点了，怎么知道它没坏？
must_do: state that anchor mode is detected by the marker phrase 'anchor, not a summary'
verify the three invariants: named files exist, all three slots named, under 900 chars
verify the ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md pull pointer is installed, since the anchor depends on it
must_not_do: run clause-coverage comparison against an anchor, which is meaningless by construction
declare success without checking the pointer
cases.failure_mode_if_wrong: An anchor without a working pointer is worse than a summary: the model is told to read files it is never sent to, and no clause reaches the prompt at all.

cases.prompt: 我刚用 create-partner 建好了一个新伙伴，为什么 Agent 选择器里没有它？
must_do: ask whether the role was mounted as a preset at all, since only presets appear in the picker
distinguish the four tiers: preset, skill, AGENTS.md chain, profile bundle
if a bootstrap block exists in ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md for this role, name it as the mis-mount and propose the preset tier
state the restart requirement: the registry mounts once per process
must_not_do: tell the user to reinstall anything before identifying the tier mismatch
suggest another AGENTS.md block as the fix
cases.failure_mode_if_wrong: The partner stays invisible in the picker while its contract keeps polluting every session.

cases.prompt: 我的 agent.cordis.yml 一解析就报 could not determine a constructor for the tag，文件哪里坏了？
must_do: identify !!js as a legitimate runtime-expression tag, not file corruption
register a pass-through constructor for tag:yaml.org,2002:js before parsing
must_not_do: rewrite the file to remove the tag rows
report the composition as broken
cases.failure_mode_if_wrong: A working platform-conditional composition gets 'fixed' into a broken one.

cases.prompt: scaffold_preset 报 ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: Cannot find package 'undefined'，官方包坏了吗？
must_do: identify 'undefined' as the imported specifier, i.e. an argv indexing bug under `node -e` where user args start at argv[1]
check the module specifier is a raw file:// path, not percent-encoded (@ becomes %40 and breaks relative import resolution)
must_not_do: reinstall or downgrade the presets package
report the platform API as broken
cases.failure_mode_if_wrong: A working platform API gets blamed and reimplemented locally — recreating the exact wheel the delegation was meant to remove.
